text:
On a grey March afternoon in 2019, the crowd inside the Authority's hall fell quiet as the curtain came away from the model. The roof of Ninefold Stadium, a pale arc that seemed to hover above its tiny stands, was shown to the public for the first time on 14 March.

Its designer, Kaito Brennan, stood a little apart while Marisol Achterberg, Chair of the Ninefold Stadium Development Authority, confirmed him as lead roof designer. The Structural Design Dossier (Revision C), ratified at the Authority's public board session, set out the particulars: a span of 212 meters, built at a cost of 87 million credits.

Years on, the figures still read as a quiet wager that a city could build something both vast and light.
